speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have persistent bleeding after your wisdom tooth extraction and a history of easy bruising; to begin our assessment, have you experienced any excessive bleeding during childhood, such as prolonged bleeding from minor cuts or nosebleeds?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient was brought in by his mother for persistent bleeding following elective removal of wisdom teeth. The bleeding from the surrounding gums was minimally responsive to multiple gauze packs. The patient also has a history of easy bruising. Family history includes the patient's uncle who had similar issues with bleeding and a history of easy bruising and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details, but I must verify the specific nature of your bleeding and family history. You mentioned your uncle had joint swelling; did he also experience spontaneous bleeding into his joints or muscles? Additionally, has your bleeding ever required hospitalization or blood transfusions?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Persistent bleeding from gums following tooth extraction. I also have History of easy bruising, Family history of similar bleeding problems and joint swelling.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilia A or B (likely Hemophilia A given the family history of joint swelling/hemarthrosis, suggesting an X-linked recessive bleeding disorder).
